blocks.heading: Digital Solutions for *Cyber Security Firms*
blocks.lead: Build trust and demonstrate expertise with secure, professional digital platforms.

header.title: Solutions for *Security Companies*
header.subtitle: Digital platforms designed specifically for cyber security firms and managed security service providers.

items.title: Security Assessment Portals
items.body: Client portals for vulnerability reports, penetration testing results, and security score dashboards with real-time updates.

items.title: Incident Response Systems
items.body: Streamlined incident tracking, ticket management, and client communication platforms with secure document sharing.

items.title: Compliance Management
items.body: Tools for tracking regulatory compliance, audit preparation, and certification management with automated reporting.

items.title: Threat Intelligence Dashboards
items.body: Real-time threat visualization, risk scoring, and executive reporting dashboards for client presentations.

items.title: Training & Awareness Platforms
items.body: Employee security training portals with phishing simulations, progress tracking, and certification management.

items.title: Secure Client Onboarding
items.body: Automated onboarding workflows with secure document collection, KYC verification, and service agreement management.

header.title: How we *deliver*
header.subtitle: Security-first development approach with compliance and trust built into every solution.

items.title: Security Assessment
items.body: We conduct a thorough security assessment of your requirements and design systems with defense-in-depth principles.

items.title: Secure Architecture
items.body: We design architecture following OWASP guidelines, with encryption, access controls, and audit trails built in.

items.title: Compliant Development
items.body: We develop with continuous security testing, code reviews, and compliance validation throughout the process.

items.title: Penetration Testing
items.body: We conduct thorough penetration testing before launch and provide ongoing security monitoring and updates.

blocks.heading: Ready to secure your *digital presence?*
blocks.body: Book a free 30-minute call. We'll discuss your security requirements and build a compliant solution.
